# Lyrenza Lima Miraflores

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Lima Miraflores is in Lima, Peru, in the South America region.
Facilities: Ocean-view pool; ceviche restaurant; airport transfers. Pool or water-facility hours: 07:00-21:00.
Parking: Valet parking; PEN 55 nightly. Transportation: Prebooked airport transfer available.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
